hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: An array is special if every pair of adjacent elements has differing parity.

hints.title: Parity Condition
hints.text: Check whether nums[i] % 2 equals nums[i - 1] % 2 for any adjacent indices.

hints.title: Single Pass
hints.text: Iterate from index 1 to n - 1. If any adjacent pair shares identical parity, return false; otherwise return true.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass testing adjacent remainder equality.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; single scan is already minimal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Check pairwise modulo two equality in a single linear pass.
